name: Sources and uses
reader_question: Where does a financing package come from, and what does it pay for?
relationship: Two stacked columns that reconcile: Σ sources = Σ uses.
use_when: A single package has stated sources and stated uses that total the same amount
The split between public, private and debt sources matters
avoid_when: Sources and uses do not reconcile — show the gap explicitly or use parallel-basis-panels
Components mix committed and conditional capital — use status-separated-capital
units: One currency and time basis for both sides.

editable: Stacked column chart with embedded workbook (Edit Data)
Component labels are native text boxes
not_data_bound: Side labels and totals are text boxes positioned from the fixture; update them if values change

table_alternative: A two-block table (sources with amounts, uses with amounts, matching totals).
variations: Percent-stacked columns when only shares matter
limitations: Does not show timing or conditions of each source

excluded_alternatives.reason: Hides the reconciliation and compares angles
Implies source-to-use allocation that the package rarely states
